title: genista triacanthos subsp. scorpioides
intro: Genista triacanthos subsp. scorpioides, commonly known as the Scorpion Spineless or Scorpioides Spiny Pea, is a subspecies of the annual shrub Genista triacanthos. It is a flowering plant that belongs to the pea family and is native to the Mediterranean region. The Scorpion Spineless has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce stress and improve cardiovascular health. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are believed to contribute to its therapeutic actions, including analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant effects.
